notes.title: Devlog #6 - Night Club
notes.notes:
Hello Yakuza Family Members!


Hello, and welcome in our #6 Devlog. We are really excited to show you how the game is getting into shape!

This time we prepared for you gang fight in the night club. The night club is gonna be one of the businesses in the city that you can take control over. But in order to achieve that there’s gonna be a hell of a fight! Train your people to take advantage of various weapons and deal with the enemies. The time to build your empire is near and it’s coming!

[previewyoutube=U6P2Uu8fpvc;full][/previewyoutube]

We are waiting for your opinions and ideas, let us know in the comments if you like it! 
Don’t forget to visit our discord https://discord.com/invite/B48g4PD - exclusive production materials coming soon!

Don't forget to add our game to wishlist.
See you next time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #5 - Environment
notes.notes:
Dear Yakuza Gang Members!

Hello, and welcome in our #5 Devlog. We are really excited for this release and big things that are coming your way!

We’ve prepared a full 3d model of a city, divided into districts. You will be able to walk freely over the district with your gang. Buildings in the district can be conquered by your gang to either collect the tribute or open your own business in town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/d570f7da3bd4f1ce34a6e784c37abd7fec9a2804.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/8d28d92f4bdc8098398e88162383d9ad035f8604.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/988170f7902ba3fef88eca5ecf632de3bdb4262b.jpg[/img]

As a second news there’s part of our battle system. You will be able to move your gang members on a specially prepared grid. As you can see there are two different colors - each marking possible moves while using one action point. Obstacles can be used as a cover for your crew. You will see a shield that shows you the direction of cover while moving your mouse on a grid close to the obstacle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/8a295be9732d9efb1dbd746650aa76e411b68c3e.gif[/img]

We are waiting for your opinions and ideas, let us know in the comments if you like it! 
Don’t forget to visit our discord https://discord.com/invite/B48g4PD - exclusive production materials coming soon!

Don't forget to add our game to wishlist.
See you next time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Tokyo Map
notes.notes:
Hello Yakuza Clan Members!

This time we present you our current stage of work on Tokyo Map, where whole action will take place. Colors will inform the player, which area of the city is under his control, and which he still has to conquer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/baf8adc626bff995a988731a492272aacfed7287.gif[/img]

This part of game is still in development so expect visual changes and improvements.

If you have any suggestions on how to improve our game, or just want to say hello to our team, join our discord by clicking link: https://discord.gg/B48g4PD

Don't forget to add our game to wishlist.
See you next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Player controls
notes.notes:
Hello Yakuza Clan Members!

We still work on our strategy mode system that will allow you to fight with enemy clans. We started working on enemy artificial intelligence and made possible for our characters to change weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/828927c99f23cb0248a31965daa32ac89de41320.gif[/img]

We have also successfully implemented basic player controls and camera that will allow you to view battlefield in 360 degrees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/00bec3e3a78a95c6331c1b8d8808464e7c2f84a0.gif[/img]

Thanks to everyone who visited our discord, and for those who don't, check it out by clicking in this link: https://discord.gg/B48g4PD

Also, don't forget to add our game to wishlist so you don't miss news from our team.
Till next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Strategy mode
notes.notes:
Hello Yakuza Gang Members!

We are currently working on a combat mode that you will be able to participate in by sending your gang members on missions.

You'll be able to do many things: move through many different levels, hide behind covers, attack enemies both from close and far, and even throw grenades at them (which you will create in your headquarters).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/ca0e0e7f84eee35eca0b513267a5ec96ac8d68a7.jpg[/img]

You'll be able to manage each gang member separately, both on and off the battlefield. There will be possibility to match the appearance and colors to your preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/caa0ae3074942698d4a9be617f34c29a40b7da42.gif[/img]

We are also working on the style and appearance of the game, trying to adapt to the realities of the Yakuza era.

Thanks to everyone who visited our discord and provided their suggestions. For those of you who haven't done it yet, we invite you to visit: https://discord.gg/B48g4PD

Add our game to your wish list so you don't miss the release day.
See you next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38451539/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

notes.title: First devlog
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

This is the first announcement devlog of our upcoming game Yakuza Empire, where you will rule one of the gangs in Tokyo and lead it to city domination. 

Currently, we finished creating the first elements of the game vibe and are working on pushing life into our gang members. They will be able to walk, run shoot, and kill on your orders and amusement. 

Come and say hello to our discord channel: https://discord.gg/B48g4PD

We wait for your suggestions and ideas!
